subject.title: fix: reject invalid channel account selections

question: Should upgraded integrations that explicitly supply an invalid, disabled, conflicting, nonexistent, or channel-mismatched account now fail rather than borrowing another configured account?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes a compatibility fallback used by existing integrations; the PR body states the desired policy, but a contributor assertion and automated labels are not a maintainer-confirmed product contract.

options.title: Confirm strict explicit routing
options.body: Merge the change once current-base checks settle, making invalid explicit account selection a clear error while preserving omitted and host-derived defaults.

options.title: Preserve legacy fallback
options.body: Keep fallback delivery for existing explicit invalid selections and pursue a separately designed opt-in strict-routing contract instead.

recommendation.title: Confirm strict explicit routing
recommendation.body: Merge the change once current-base checks settle, making invalid explicit account selection a clear error while preserving omitted and host-derived defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: They can explain the proposed routing boundary and validation coverage; a project maintainer must make the final compatibility decision.
